'''B'arud''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked in the [[Applied Medical Sciences Division]] of the [[Military Medical Services]]. B'arud compiled a report on the effects of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]'s "madness waves" on [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] there.
